blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Дважды-Венчанный ___ (поставить) кружку и удивленно поглядел на него.
exercises.why: «The past tense is formed by dropping -ть from the infinitive and adding -л for the masculine, -ла for the feminine, -ло for the neuter, -ли for the plural … the past does not have special endings for each person, but shows the gender and the number.» — DLI, Lesson 36. From Викентий Вересаев, «Состязание».
exercises.context: «The past tense is formed by dropping -ть from the infinitive and adding -л for the masculine, -ла for the feminine, -ло for the neuter, -ли for the plural … the past does not have special endings for each person, but shows the gender and the number.» — DLI,…

exercises.q: ___ (мочь) быть, ты и прав.
exercises.why: The letter с in the infinitive form писать is replaced by the letter ш in all forms of the present tense. The letter в is inserted in all present tense forms of the verb жить. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 16–18.  ·  «The following verbs belong to the "Е" type of conjugation: думать, слушать, спрашивать … The verb лежать belongs to the "И" type of conjugation.» — DLI, Lesson 16. From Викентий Вересаев, «Состязание».
exercises.context: The letter с in the infinitive form писать is replaced by the letter ш in all forms of the present tense.

exercises.q: И ___ (отшатнуть / отшатнуться) свет от тени, и разъединились они.
exercises.why: «We already know that the verbs in "-ся" may be divided into several groups … Reflexive verbs. These verbs express an action which is directed back upon the agent or subject … Reciprocal verbs. The suffix "-ся" with these verbs indicates action of two or more actors upon one another … Verbs which never occur without the ending "-ся".» — DLI, Lesson 67. From Викентий Вересаев, «Состязание».
exercises.context: «We already know that the verbs in "-ся" may be divided into several groups … Reflexive verbs. These verbs express an action which is directed back upon the agent or subject … Reciprocal verbs.…

exercises.q: Сердце Дважды-Венчанного ___ (забиться / забиваться) медленными, сильными толчками, груди стало мало воздуху, а седая голова задрожала.
exercises.why: The verb написать is called perfective and expresses a single action with emphasis on its completion (either in the past or in the future, since the present tense deals only with actions in progress). Both the imperfective and perfective forms of a Russian verb are to be memorized as a pair because there are no definite rules of forming one aspect from the other one: some twin-verbs differ only by a prefix in the perfective aspect; some have other changes: читать — прочитать, получать — получить. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  From Викентий Вересаев, «Состязание».
exercises.context: The verb написать is called perfective and expresses a single action with emphasis on its completion (either in the past or in the future, since the present tense deals only with actions in progress).
